meta: Kids using AI for homework: copying the answer finishes the work fast, but they learn nothing. How parents turn AI into a tutor that hints step by step.
prompt: I'm in grade 5. Don't give me the answer, give me hints step by step.

muc.title: Copying answers from AI
muc.text: Copying answers from AI finishes homework fast, but your child learns nothing new.

muc.title: Right answers, empty head
muc.text: Every answer handed in is right, but in a class test without AI, your child doesn't know where to start.

muc.title: Turn AI into a tutor
muc.text: Tell AI to act as a tutor: no answers, only step-by-step hints, and questions back so your child thinks for themselves.

muc.title: Let AI make more exercises
muc.text: When they're done, ask AI for three similar problems for your child to solve alone, and wherever they go wrong, AI explains exactly that part again.

muc.title: The tutor instruction
muc.text: With your child, type this at the start of the chat: I'm in grade 5, don't give me the answer, give me hints step by step.
